name: Exp_ROC2_VG
summary: This EA uses a dual Rate-of-Change (ROC2_VG) custom indicator with two configurable momentum-type calculations (MOM, ROC, ROCP, ROCR, ROCR100) on different periods to generate crossover signals for opening and closing buy/sell positions. It features money management options, stop loss/take profit, signal inversion, and processes signals only on new bars for efficiency.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双速率变化(ROC2_VG)自定义指标，通过两个不同周期的可配置动量类型计算(MOM、ROC、ROCP、ROCR、ROCR100)生成交叉信号来开仓和平仓买卖方向的头寸。具备资金管理选项、止损止盈、信号反转功能，并仅在新K线时处理信号以提高效率。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双动量指标交叉的核心概念，使用两个不同周期（默认8和14）的ROC类型指标，当快速动量线向上穿越慢速动量线时产生买入信号，向下穿越时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：快速指标线从下方穿越慢速线（金叉）时买入开仓，从上方穿越（死叉）时卖出开仓，信号仅在指定K线（SignalBar）上检测且需前一K线确认穿越。出场条件包括：反向穿越信号触发平仓、止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等。资金管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的标准化函数，支持5种保证金计算模式。策略还提供了信号反转功能(Invert)，可将买卖信号互换，适用于逆势交易场景。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is based on a dual momentum indicator crossover concept, using two ROC-type indicators with different periods (default 8 and 14) to generate signals when the fast momentum line crosses above or below the slow momentum line. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the fast indicator crosses above the slow indicator (golden cross), and a sell signal when it crosses below (death cross), with crossover confirmation requiring the previous bar to show the opposite relationship. Exit conditions include: reverse crossover signal triggers position closure, stop loss (default 1000 points), and take profit (default 2000 points). Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple modes including fixed lot size, balance percentage, free margin percentage, and others. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library providing standardized functions with 5 margin calculation modes. The strategy also provides a signal inversion feature (Invert) that swaps buy and sell signals, applicable for counter-trend trading scenarios.

pros: 支持5种动量计算类型(MOM/ROC/ROCP/ROCR/ROCR100)，策略灵活度高
具有完整的止损止盈设置和多种资金管理模式，风险控制手段较全面
仅在新K线时处理信号，避免重复交易和tick级别过度交易
提供信号反转功能，可适应不同市场环境
可独立控制买入卖出的开仓和平仓开关，灵活度高
pros_en: Supports 5 momentum calculation types (MOM/ROC/ROCP/ROCR/ROCR100) providing high strategy flexibility
Has complete stop loss/take profit settings and multiple money management modes for comprehensive risk control
Processes signals only on new bars, avoiding repeated trades and tick-level overtrading
Provides signal inversion feature to adapt to different market conditions
Independent buy/sell open and close switches allow fine-grained position control
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标ROC2_VG和库文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh，缺少这些文件则无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，在H4周期下可能不适合所有品种
没有扩展过滤机制（如趋势确认、波动率过滤），纯动量交叉容易在震荡市中频繁假信号
缺少最大持仓数限制和单日最大亏损限制等风控措施
CopyBuffer仅读取2个数据点做穿越判断，在数据加载不完整时可能产生错误信号
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator ROC2_VG and library TradeAlgorithms.mqh, cannot run without them
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments on H4
No additional filters (trend confirmation, volatility filter), pure momentum crossover prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
Lacks maximum position count limit and daily max loss limit risk controls
CopyBuffer reads only 2 data points for crossover detection, which may produce false signals when data is incomplete
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线方向判断），避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓
添加最大同时持仓数限制和账户级别风险控制（如最大回撤限制、每日最大亏损限制）
增加指标数据有效性的额外检查，避免CopyBuffer返回不完整数据时产生错误信号
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid frequent entries in ranging markets
Add maximum simultaneous position limits and account-level risk controls (max drawdown limit, daily max loss limit)
Add additional validation for indicator data integrity to prevent false signals when CopyBuffer returns incomplete data

risk_points: 纯动量交叉策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
默认止损1000点对于某些品种可能过大，单笔亏损可能较显著
缺少最大持仓数和账户风险上限控制，极端行情下风险敞口不可控
risk_points_en: Pure momentum crossover strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Default 1000-point stop loss may be too large for some instruments, causing significant single-trade losses
Lacks maximum position count and account risk ceiling controls, leaving risk exposure uncontrolled in extreme markets

It features money management options, stop loss/take profit, signal inversion, and processes signals only on new bars for efficiency.
